provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled measurement study; stated matrices/counts are stipulated model inputs, not new experimental observations.
provenance.scope: No external factual retrieval is required. Source roles, axes and units are stated in the file.

model: Independent scalar readings obey y=beta0+beta1*x+beta2*x^2+epsilon, with known variance1 in response-unit squared. All historical and additional x are exact dimensionless settings. There is no unknown noise scale to re-estimate. Compare the covariance of the ordinary least-squares coefficient estimator conditional on these settings. All candidates cost exactly two readings and all are feasible. Future response values are not needed for design precision.
target: Minimize variance of beta2 in the fixed [1,x,x^2] basis, not total prediction variance or determinant. Separately report the program maximizing det(X^T X); ties within1e-10 use lexicographically smallest program_id.
